I'm a DPN girl. I absolutely hate working with circular needles, I always find the cord really annoying. I actually only have one set of circular needles and I hated them so much I never bought any more.

Metal is by far my favourite material, too. I'm currently in the middle of replacing all the generic mystery metal and plastic needles that my LYS stocks with HiyaHiya stainless steel sharps. I should really invest in some decent straight needles at some point, but I don't have anything planned that would call for them so I'll cross that bridge when I come to it.
I found that I hated circular needles until I got a couple of different lengths and stuck to a couple of sizes. What standard are you using? US, UK, other?

UK. Maybe it's because my closest LYS doesn't stock particularly good needles and I'd like them more if I got better quality ones, but I find DPNs really easy to work with so unless I want to make a blanket or something that'd require long needles I don't feel the need to try them again.

I've never tried DPNs to be honest. I have been working on circulars using an interchangeable set (Addi Click, bamboo, because I'm allergic to nickel and it's got brass fitting). I use magic loop for small circular objects, it works pretty good. The circulars work great for things like blankets and lace, too.

I bought an emergency circular from a walmart once. It was bamboo, and the circular part was some kind of pvc tubing glued onto what must have been cheap DPNs. No slickness to it at all. It was awful, my yarn would not slide on the needle. I threw it out. It was completely unworkable. No salvaging that.

My soulmate! I'm a firm DPN user and find nothing more irritating than that cord. I'm also a fan of metal, probably because my stitches run a bit tight and metal slides so nicely. I do have one set of 3.5mm wooden needles that I take when flying, just in case there's an issue and because the wood has more friction and I lose fewer stitches when moving about.

My favourite needles to use are a pair of generic metal 4mm needles. It's just the most comfortable size to hold, for my hands..

I always have trouble with DPN when I first started out knitting. Then I discover the Magic Loop method. Making socks and even some top down hats so much easier. It sometime seems hard to do a hat on circular needles due to less stitches and the size of the cable (I have interchangeable needles).
